$comment: UltraVideo design tokens: the source of the live pages' tokens.css and of Apps/UltraVideo/UltraVideoTokens.h (scripts/generate_ultravideo_tokens.py). Colours are hex or rgba; lengths are logical pixels.

bg-000.description: App ground: the gutters between panels and the area behind the viewer image.

bg-100.description: Panel surface: media bin, inspector, timeline body, menus.

bg-200.description: Track lanes in the timeline; inset wells such as fields and the waveform lane.

bg-300.description: Raised surfaces: track headers, the ruler, toolbar buttons at rest, popovers.

bg-400.description: Hover fill for rows, buttons and track headers.

bg-500.description: Pressed or active-toggle fill for controls.

line.description: Hairline dividers between tracks, panels and menu sections. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a cont

line-strong.description: Control borders, splitter grips, ruler ticks. Meets 3:1 on bg-100 and bg-300.

ink.description: Primary text and icons on every bg-* surface and on every clip-* fill.

ink-muted.description: Secondary text: track names at rest, inspector labels, duration badges. On bg-000…bg-400.

ink-faint.description: Ruler timecodes, placeholders, disabled labels. On bg-100…bg-300 only.

accent.description: Identity amber: primary button fill, selection outlines, active tool, work-area range, the transition drag han

accent-soft.description: Tinted background behind selected list rows and the active tool; text on it stays ink.

on-accent.description: Text and icons on an accent fill.

playhead.description: The playhead line and its ruler handle. Never used for anything else.

focus.description: Keyboard focus ring (2px solid), snap line, file-drop target outline. Meets 3:1 on every surface and clip fill

danger.description: Destructive menu items and error text; always paired with a word.

clip-video.description: Body of a video clip on a video track.

clip-video-edge.description: Top band and border of a video clip; trim-handle grip on video clips.

clip-image.description: Body of a still-image clip (photo with motion).

clip-image-edge.description: Top band and border of a still-image clip.

clip-card.description: Body of a colour-card clip when the card colour itself is not shown (collapsed tracks).

clip-card-edge.description: Top band and border of a colour-card clip.

clip-title.description: Title and overlay spans on the overlay lane.

clip-title-edge.description: Top band and border of title and overlay spans.

clip-audio.description: Body of the music bar and audio clips.

clip-audio-edge.description: Top band, border and fade ramps of audio.

transition-fill.description: Transition badge over a cut: deliberately inverted so it reads above any clip colour.

beat.description: Beat-mark ticks drawn across all lanes. Decorative guide, never interactive.

trim-overflow.description: Ghost extension beyond a clip edge showing unused source media while hovering or trimming.

drop-soft.description: Fill of a valid drop zone during a file or media-bin drag.

range-fill.description: Work-area in/out range on the ruler and the lanes beneath it.

muted-hatch.description: Scrim laid over a muted clip together with the crossed-speaker icon.

2.description: Control padding, gap between toolbar buttons.

3.description: Panel inner padding, menu item horizontal padding.

xs.description: Markers, badges inside clips, ruler handles.

md.description: Panels, menus, tooltips, thumbnails in the media bin.

lg.description: Dialogs and the empty-state drop zone.

toolbar-h.description: Timeline toolbar and viewer transport bar.

ruler-h.description: Time ruler height including the marker strip.

track-header-w.description: Width of the track header column.

track-h-audio.description: Default audio and music track height.

track-h-min.description: Collapsed track height (name only, no thumbnails).

clip-band-h.description: Clip top band holding name and badges.

handle-w.description: Hit width of a clip trim handle (drawn 3px wide).

splitter-w.description: Hit width of panel splitters; drawn as a 1px line.

base.description: Neighbour clips sliding aside during reorder, panel collapse.

title.description: Panel titles (Media, Inspector), dialog section heads.

body.description: Default UI text: inspector values, menu items, tooltips.

label.description: Buttons, track names, clip names, tab labels.

caption.description: Badges on clips, secondary metadata, keyboard hints in menus.

timecode-lg.description: Current playhead time in the viewer transport and timeline toolbar.

timecode.description: Timecode fields, hover readout, inspector in/out values.

timecode-sm.description: Ruler labels and duration badges where space is tight.
